description: Browse published provider and media profile summaries by text, category and review status; filters combine with AND. Returns page, total_items, total_pages and items with slugs, URLs and evidence-readiness scores; desk-reviewed profiles sort first, then names alphabetically. Defaults to page 1 with 10 records. Use search for meaning-based questions and get_supplier for full evidence. Media records use the media category and carry no provider rating.

category.description: Match this category exactly. Omit for all categories; media selects publication profiles.

limit.description: Records per page, from 1 to 20 (default 10). Use page to continue; total_items and total_pages describe all matches.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1, maximum 500). Keep filters and limit unchanged while paging; stop at total_pages. A page beyond the results returns an empty items array.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring in the name or summary, up to 200 characters. Omit or leave empty to browse; this is not semantic search.

review_status.description: Match editorial review status: desk-reviewed for reviewed profiles, research-candidate for profiles awaiting review. Omit for both; this is not a claim-verification filter.

name: search_suppliers
title: Search providers
